claim: By default, you can create up to 50 data streams with the on-demand capacity mode in an AWS account. There is no upper quota on the total number of streams, and the 50-stream default can be raised with a support ticket.
question: How many on-demand Kinesis data streams can an account create by default?

qualifiers.scope: per AWS account, on-demand capacity mode

evidence.quote: By default, you can create up to 50 data streams with the on-demand capacity mode.

claim: A data stream can have up to 20 registered enhanced fan-out consumers in On-demand Standard and Provisioned modes. With On-demand Advantage mode the limit is up to 50 registered consumers per stream.
question: How many enhanced fan-out consumers can one Kinesis data stream have, and what raises the limit?

qualifiers.condition: 50 only with On-demand Advantage mode, and only in the Regions the guide lists; 20 for On-demand Standard and Provisioned modes

evidence.quote: With On-demand Advantage mode, you can register up to 50 consumers per stream to use enhanced fan-out. With On-demand Standard and Provisioned streams, you can register up to 20 consumers per stream to use enhanced fan-out.
